question: Where are a museum located within a 120 kilometers radius to the north of Broadbent Arena, Louisville, KY?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE museum IS NOT NULL AND ST_DWithin( pois.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Broadbent Arena%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 120000 ) AND ST_Y(pois.geometry) > ST_Y( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Broadbent Arena%' LIMIT 1 ) );
